policy: Two separate chromophore-plus-stacked-Tyr QM/MM TDDFTs are required for every retained dimer/MM frame. Archived retry directories are preserved but excluded from the retained count. This audit never launches or replaces a calculation.

qm_region.composition: 29-atom anionic CR2 chromophore + 12-atom stacked Tyr phenol + 3 link hydrogens
qm_region.link_atom_density_policy: Atoms 42-44 are retained in QM electronic-structure jobs and excluded from compact transition densities and TDC.

environment: Both site jobs use the same instantaneous full-dimer NVT frame with the validated fixed frame-0 local MM point-charge identities; only one chromophore-plus-Tyr region is QM in each job.
restart_semantics: The production worker skips a site whose retained td_density.out contains 'Job finished:' and resumes only a missing/incomplete site; a complete frame manifest prevents duplicate paired jobs.
